1849 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
June 16, 1849 minus 64 days:  
Back up 16 days to May 31, 1849.  
Remaining 64 − 16 = 48 days.  
May has 31 days, so back to April 30 (1 day), then April 30 back 47 more days:  
April has 30 days, so back to March 31 (30 days), leaving 17 days.  
March 31 back 17 days = March 14, 1849.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1849-03-14
